analysisMode.subtitle: Where 3,000 years of Eastern wisdom meets modern science
analysisMode.scienceExplain:
MIRi explores fascinating connections between traditional Eastern fortune-telling and modern scientific research, including chronobiology (seasonal birth effects), attachment theory, micro-expression analysis, and behavioral economics.

This is not scientific proof, but an exploration of where two worldviews intersect.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
MIRi Privacy Policy

Last updated: March 15, 2026

1. Personal Information Collected
- Date and time of birth, gender (for fortune analysis)
- Facial images (for face reading, automatically deleted within 30 days after analysis)
- Social login information (email, name)

2. Purpose of Use
- Providing Four Pillars of Destiny analysis service
- Providing AI face reading service
- Providing compatibility analysis service
- Service improvement and statistical analysis

3. Retention and Destruction
- Facial images: Automatically deleted within 30 days after analysis
- Analysis results: Immediately deleted upon account deletion
- Account information: Immediately deleted upon account deletion

4. Third-Party Sharing
- We do not provide personal information to third parties in principle
- Anonymized data may be transmitted to OpenAI API for AI analysis

5. User Rights
- You may request to view, modify, or delete your personal information
- You may delete all data by deleting your account
- Contact: support@miri-app.com

6. Cookies and Tracking
- Anonymous usage statistics collected for service improvement
- Third-party ad tracking is only enabled with user consent

This service is provided for entertainment purposes and does not replace professional advice for important decisions.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body:
MIRi Terms of Service

Last updated: March 15, 2026

Article 1 (Purpose)
These terms set forth the conditions and procedures for using the mobile application services provided by MIRi (hereinafter "Service"), including Four Pillars of Destiny analysis, AI face reading, and compatibility analysis.

Article 2 (Definitions)
1. "Service" refers to the content provided by MIRi, including fortune analysis, face reading, compatibility analysis, and daily horoscopes.
2. "User" refers to a person who uses the Service in accordance with these terms.
3. "Guest User" refers to a person who uses the Service without separate registration.

Article 3 (Effectiveness and Changes)
1. These terms take effect by posting on the Service screen or by notifying users through other means.
2. The Service may change the terms within the scope that does not violate relevant laws when there is a reasonable cause.

Article 4 (Service Content)
1. Fortune Analysis: Traditional destiny analysis based on date and time of birth
2. AI Face Reading: Face reading analysis using facial images
3. Compatibility Analysis: Compatibility analysis comparing two people's fortunes
4. Daily/Yearly Horoscope: Fortune information by date

Article 5 (Nature of Service)
1. This Service is provided for entertainment purposes.
2. Analysis results are for reference only and do not replace professional judgment in medical, legal, financial, or other fields.
3. Users must make independent judgments regarding the Service's analysis results.

Article 6 (Paid Services)
1. Basic analysis is provided free of charge; detailed analysis is provided for a fee.
2. Prices for paid content are based on the amounts displayed in the app.
3. Payments are processed through Apple App Store or Google Play Store.
4. Due to the nature of digital content, refunds may be limited after content has been viewed.

Article 7 (User Obligations)
1. Users must not use the Service by misappropriating others' personal information.
2. Users must not use information obtained through the Service for unauthorized commercial purposes.

Article 8 (Disclaimers)
1. The Service is not responsible for service interruptions due to force majeure such as natural disasters or system failures.
2. The Service is not responsible for users' judgments and actions based on analysis results.

Article 9 (Dispute Resolution)
1. Disputes between the Service and users shall be governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea.
2. The competent court in case of dispute shall be the court having jurisdiction over the location of the Service provider.

Article 10 (Contact)
Service inquiries: support@miri-app.com
